summary.text: Drew Gattine (listed by Ballotpedia as Andrew Gattine) is a Democratic state representative from Westbrook, Maine, who represents District 126 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He represented District 34 from 2012 to 2020 and chaired the Maine Democratic Party beginning in 2021.

paragraphs.text: Gattine lives in Westbrook, Maine, and his career experience includes working as a health care program manager.

Gattine represented Maine House District 34 from 2012 to 2020, and Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Health and Human Services Committee in 2015 and of the Appropriations and Financial Affairs Committee in 2017 and 2019-2020.
He was elected by party leadership to a two-year term as chair of the Maine Democratic Party on January 24, 2021.
He returned to the House on December 6, 2022, representing District 126, and Ballotpedia lists him on the Appropriations and Financial Affairs Committee for 2023-2024.
